name: Darius
bio: Darius the Mede took over the kingdom after Belshazzar's fall and appointed Daniel as one of three chief administrators over 120 provincial governors. When Daniel's excellence provoked jealous rivals, they tricked Darius into signing an irrevocable decree banning prayer to anyone but the king for thirty days, specifically to trap Daniel. Though grieved when Daniel was caught praying to God and had to be thrown to the lions as the law required, Darius fasted and worried all night, then rushed to the den at dawn and rejoiced to find Daniel unharmed; he had the conspirators thrown to the lions instead and decreed that all his kingdom should fear Daniel's God (Daniel 6:1-28). He is a different figure from Darius, king of Persia, who confirmed Cyrus's decree to rebuild the Jerusalem temple.
